architecture.controlPlane: All providers are loaded by the generated lazy registry and execute through the tenant-scoped Connection Service, encrypted credential store, ACL/visibility checks, ConnectionLease, action policy, audit store, and catalog enablement.
architecture.credentialHandling: Only encrypted credential ciphertext is persisted. Profiles and action results are redacted. Runtime code does not call lark-cli, DingTalk CLI, browser sessions, or Studio-managed credentials.
architecture.egress: Provider egress uses the shared guarded fetch or explicit guarded endpoint validation. User-supplied source URLs remain public-only. Alibaba OSS SDK requests use a custom urllib adapter backed by the injected guarded fetch and bounded response reads.
architecture.boundedReads: Object downloads use transit storage and readBoundedResponseBytes. Office and object listing actions expose bounded pages or cursors. Control-plane discovery requires a verified ConnectionLease for the provider discover_resources action.
architecture.writePolicy: TOS exposes no write/delete/presign actions. Existing S3/OSS write actions remain catalog/runtime compatibility surfaces and require the existing control-plane lease to be explicitly scoped.
